h:
决定为我的工作流程制作一个更干净和升级的版本。适用于任何模型，但可能需要对某些模型进行调整（我认为）

如果您希望绕过可选节点，请在选择节点时按 ctrl + B

如果它显示有关缺少节点的信息，请转到 Comfy 的管理器并单击“安装缺少的自定义节点”

享受吧！

o.en:
Decided to make a cleaner and upgraded version of my workflow. Works with any model, but it may require tweaking for some models (I think)

If you wish to bypass the optional nodes, press ctrl + B while having the node selected

If it says something about missing nodes, go to Comfy's manager and click "install missing custom nodes"

Enjoy!
